name: quicken-mac-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Quicken For Mac financial data — Claude Skill plus MCP server

database_path.title: Database Path
database_path.description: Path to your .quicken/data file. Leave empty to auto-detect from ~/Documents.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all Quicken accounts with name, type, and active/closed status. Optionally filter by account type (case-insensitive).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all Quicken category tags with their parent category hierarchy. Categories classify transactions (e.g., Food & Dining > Groceries).

tools.name: query_transactions
tools.description: Query Quicken transactions with flexible filters. Returns one row per split entry — a single transaction may appear multiple times if it has multiple category splits.

tools.name: spending_by_category
tools.description: Aggregate consumer spending (negative splits) by category for an inclusive date range. Excludes transfers and report-excluded transactions, preserves an (Uncategorized) bucket, and defaults to checking + credit-card accounts.

tools.name: spending_over_time
tools.description: Monthly consumer-spending totals (negative splits) for an inclusive date range, optionally by parent category. Excludes transfers and report-excluded transactions, labels uncategorized rows when grouped, and defaults to checking + credit-card accounts.

tools.name: search_payees
tools.description: Search payees by name (case-insensitive LIKE match). Returns payee name and total transaction count, sorted by frequency.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description: List current investment holdings across all brokerage/retirement accounts. Shows shares, cost basis, and enriches with stored Quicken quotes to compute market value and gain/loss.

tools.name: raw_query
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary read-only SQL query against the Quicken database. Only SELECT statements are allowed. Results limited to 500 rows. Use this for custom analysis not covered by other tools.
